name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
kicker: Cham sandstone on the Han River
summary: More than 400 Cham sandstone and terracotta carvings, from the 5th to the 15th century, fill galleries on the Han River, grouped by the sites they came from: My Son, Tra Kieu, Dong Duong, and Thap Mam. An hour on a river morning is enough. Go before My Son, because much of the sanctuary's sculpture is here.
getThere: On the Han River in Hai Chau, a walk from a river hotel.
heroCaption: The museum building from the garden path

notice.title: Doors close at 17:00
notice.body: An afternoon after the beach is too late. Give the galleries a morning, then go to the sand.

body: Walk the galleries before you give the day to the beach. More than 400 works, from the 5th to the 15th century, are grouped by the places they were found, including My Son, Tra Kieu, Dong Duong, and Thap Mam. The building opened in 1919.

A general ticket is 60,000 VND. Da Nang residents and university, college, and vocational students pay 20,000 VND. Children under 16, school pupils, and Vietnamese citizens 60 and over are free. Everyone enters free on the first day of Tet, 29 March, Hung Kings’ day, 2 September, and 24 November.

The museum holds sculpture from the sanctuary. The towers themselves are still in the My Son valley. Use the hour as the start of that story, not a substitute for it. If the beach already has the morning, skip it.

figures.caption: A Cham sandstone relief in the collection
figures.alt: A carved Cham sandstone stele of a seated deity at the Museum of Cham Sculpture in Da Nang

gettingThere: The museum is on the Han River in Hai Chau, a walk from a river hotel. Its address is No. 2, 2 Thang 9 Street, also given as 01 Trung Nu Vuong, Hai Chau ward. It is one building.

legs.heading: From the Han River
legs.body: Walk along the river to the museum.

legs.heading: From My Khe
legs.body: By car or Grab across the river.

hours: 07:00–17:00 (Visit Da Nang); 07:30–17:00 (2026 city price list). Check on arrival.

Free for all on the first day of Tet, 29 March, Hung Kings’ day, 2 September, and 24 November. Resolution 47/2026 and the 2026 city price list agree on 60,000 and 20,000 VND.
